difficulty_reason: Properness of a closed subset over the base is independent of the subscheme structure: (3)=>(1)=>(2) immediate; for (2)=>(3) form the scheme-theoretic union Z''' = Z' u Z'' of two structures, factor Z'' -> S through the closed immersion Z'' -> Z'''; the bijective closed immersion Z' -> Z''' transfers separatedness (via the universally-closed-image lemma), local finite type, quasi-compactness (homeomorphism), and universal closedness (image-proper-is-proper). The author's aside 'We urge the reader to find their own proof' is rhetorical - the complete argument follows immediately. Retained author proof at lines 7444-7475.

compared.note: Closed-subset properness invariance; distinct from lemma-systems-with-proper-support and lemma-functoriality-closed-proper-over-base (withdrawn) which concern sheaf supports.
